Apple___Apple_scab.symptoms: Olive-green to black velvet-like spots on leaves and fruit, causing leaf drop.
Apple___Apple_scab.chemical_treatment: Apply Captan 50 WP (2g per liter water) or Myclobutanil early in the season.
Apple___Apple_scab.organic_remedy: Neem oil spray (5ml/L) or copper octanoate fungicide every 7 to 10 days.
Apple___Apple_scab.prevention: Rake and destroy fallen leaves in autumn; prune trees to ensure proper sunlight & air circulation.

Apple___Black_rot.symptoms: Frog-eye spots on leaves, black rot on fruit, and reddish-brown stem cankers.
Apple___Black_rot.chemical_treatment: Spray Captan or Thiophanate-methyl starting at pink bud stage through harvest.
Apple___Black_rot.organic_remedy: Liquid copper fungicide spray combined with sulfur applications.
Apple___Black_rot.prevention: Prune out dead wood and cankers; remove mummified fruits from trees and ground.

Apple___Cedar_apple_rust.symptoms: Bright orange-yellow spots on upper leaf surfaces; tube-like spore structures beneath.
Apple___Cedar_apple_rust.chemical_treatment: Apply Immunox or Myclobutanil fungicide from green tip stage until petal fall.
Apple___Cedar_apple_rust.organic_remedy: Sulfur-based fungicide sprays applied before rain events.
Apple___Cedar_apple_rust.prevention: Remove nearby eastern red cedar trees or galls within a 500-meter radius.

Apple___healthy.symptoms: Leaves are vibrant green, firm, and free of blemishes or fungal growth.
Apple___healthy.organic_remedy: Maintain regular organic compost application and balanced soil hydration.
Apple___healthy.prevention: Ensure annual pruning, proper spacing, and routine monitoring.

Blueberry___healthy.symptoms: Lush green foliage with no discoloration or wilting.
Blueberry___healthy.organic_remedy: Maintain acidic soil pH (4.5–5.5) using pine bark mulch and organic sulfur.
Blueberry___healthy.prevention: Ensure good drainage and drip irrigation to avoid leaf wetness.

Cherry_(including_sour)___Powdery_mildew.symptoms: White powdery fungal growth covering young leaves, terminals, and stems.
Cherry_(including_sour)___Powdery_mildew.chemical_treatment: Apply Myclobutanil or Potassium Bicarbonate spray upon first sign.
Cherry_(including_sour)___Powdery_mildew.organic_remedy: Baking soda solution (1 tbsp baking soda + 1 tsp liquid soap per gallon of water).
Cherry_(including_sour)___Powdery_mildew.prevention: Prune dense canopy to increase sunlight penetration and air movement.

Cherry_(including_sour)___healthy.symptoms: Clean, smooth leaf tissue with healthy venation.
Cherry_(including_sour)___healthy.organic_remedy: Apply organic mulch layer around base.
Cherry_(including_sour)___healthy.prevention: Regular water management and fall sanitation.

Corn_(maize)___Cercospora_leaf_spot Gray.symptoms: Rectangular, tan to grayish leaf lesions bounded by leaf veins.
Corn_(maize)___Cercospora_leaf_spot Gray.chemical_treatment: Apply Strobilurin or Triazole fungicides (e.g., Pyraclostrobin or Azoxystrobin).
Corn_(maize)___Cercospora_leaf_spot Gray.organic_remedy: Copper hydroxide spray applied at early tassel stage.
Corn_(maize)___Cercospora_leaf_spot Gray.prevention: Rotate crops with non-host plants (soybeans/alfalfa) and use resistant hybrid seeds.

Corn_(maize)___Common_rust_.symptoms: Oval to elongate powdery brick-red pustules on both upper and lower leaf surfaces.
Corn_(maize)___Common_rust_.chemical_treatment: Fungicides containing Mancozeb or Propiconazole if infection exceeds 5% threshold.
Corn_(maize)___Common_rust_.organic_remedy: Sulfur dusting or neem seed kernel extract (5%).
Corn_(maize)___Common_rust_.prevention: Plant resistant corn varieties and avoid late planting.

Corn_(maize)___Northern_Leaf_Blight.symptoms: Large elliptical grayish-green or tan lesions (2–15 cm long) on leaves.
Corn_(maize)___Northern_Leaf_Blight.chemical_treatment: Foliar application of Azoxystrobin + Propiconazole at tasseling.
Corn_(maize)___Northern_Leaf_Blight.prevention: Incorporate crop residues deeply into soil after harvest and practice 2-year crop rotation.

Corn_(maize)___healthy.symptoms: Robust deep green leaves with strong stalk development.
Corn_(maize)___healthy.organic_remedy: Balanced nitrogen enrichment via cover crops.
Corn_(maize)___healthy.prevention: Maintain proper plant population density and weed control.

Grape___Black_rot.symptoms: Small reddish-brown leaf spots; berries shrivel into hard black mummies.
Grape___Black_rot.chemical_treatment: Apply Mancozeb, Captan, or Ziram from bud break until 4 weeks after bloom.
Grape___Black_rot.organic_remedy: Copper soap fungicide applied weekly during high humidity.
Grape___Black_rot.prevention: Destroy mummified grapes and prune infected canes during winter dormant season.

Grape___Esca_(Black_Measles).symptoms: Tiger-stripe leaf discoloration (yellow/red between veins) and dark spots on berries.
Grape___Esca_(Black_Measles).chemical_treatment: No direct cure; apply wound sealants (Tebuconazole) after pruning cuts.
Grape___Esca_(Black_Measles).organic_remedy: Trichoderma-based biocontrol agents applied to fresh pruning wounds.
Grape___Esca_(Black_Measles).prevention: Avoid pruning in wet weather; remove severely infected vines to prevent spread.

Grape___Leaf_blight_(Isariopsis_Leaf_Spo.symptoms: Irregular dark brown leaf spots with dark fungal tufts underneath.
Grape___Leaf_blight_(Isariopsis_Leaf_Spo.chemical_treatment: Foliar spray of Copper Oxychloride (3g/L) or Carbendazim (1g/L).
Grape___Leaf_blight_(Isariopsis_Leaf_Spo.prevention: Ensure good canopy ventilation and collect/burn fallen leaves.

Grape___healthy.symptoms: Vibrant green leaves and firm fruit clusters without blemishes.
Grape___healthy.prevention: Routine training of grapevines on trellises for airflow.

Orange___Haunglongbing_(Citrus_greening).symptoms: Asymmetrical blotchy mottle on leaves, yellow shoots, small misshapen bitter fruit.
Orange___Haunglongbing_(Citrus_greening).chemical_treatment: Control Asian Citrus Psyllid vector using Imidacloprid or Thiamethoxam.
Orange___Haunglongbing_(Citrus_greening).organic_remedy: Horticultural mineral oils and insecticidal soaps to reduce vector population.
Orange___Haunglongbing_(Citrus_greening).prevention: Use certified disease-free nursery trees; immediately remove infected trees.

Peach___Bacterial_spot.symptoms: Small dark water-soaked spots on leaves turning into shot-holes; pitted fruit.
Peach___Bacterial_spot.chemical_treatment: Apply Oxytetracycline or Copper hydroxide during dormant and bloom stages.
Peach___Bacterial_spot.organic_remedy: Copper soap spray applied before leaf emergence.
Peach___Bacterial_spot.prevention: Avoid overhead irrigation and plant windbreaks to minimize leaf abrasion.

Peach___healthy.symptoms: Smooth green foliage and undamaged bark.
Peach___healthy.organic_remedy: Mulch root zone with organic wood chips.

Pepper,_bell___Bacterial_spot.symptoms: Small, dark, water-soaked leaf spots that turn brown and scab-like.
Pepper,_bell___Bacterial_spot.chemical_treatment: Apply Copper Hydroxide mixed with Mancozeb for improved bacterial control.
Pepper,_bell___Bacterial_spot.organic_remedy: Copper octanoate spray or Streptomyces lydicus bio-fungicide.
Pepper,_bell___Bacterial_spot.prevention: Use disease-free seed; practice 3-year rotation away from solanaceous crops.

Pepper,_bell___healthy.symptoms: Deep green glossy leaves without spots.
Pepper,_bell___healthy.organic_remedy: Apply well-aged manure or worm castings.
Pepper,_bell___healthy.prevention: Maintain drip irrigation and crop spacing.

Potato___Early_blight.symptoms: Concentric ring ('target board') brown spots on older lower leaves.
Potato___Early_blight.chemical_treatment: Foliar spray of Chlorothalonil, Mancozeb, or Difenoconazole every 7–14 days.
Potato___Early_blight.organic_remedy: Copper fungicide or Bacillus subtilis application at early onset.
Potato___Early_blight.prevention: Maintain adequate plant nutrition (especially Nitrogen) and destroy infected haulms.

Potato___Late_blight.symptoms: Water-soaked dark lesions on leaf tips/edges with white mold on underside in high humidity.
Potato___Late_blight.chemical_treatment: Systemic fungicides like Metalaxyl, Dimethomorph, or Cymoxanil.
Potato___Late_blight.organic_remedy: Bordeaux mixture (1%) or Copper Sulfate applied preventatively before rain.
Potato___Late_blight.prevention: Plant certified seed tubers; destroy volunteer potato plants and hill up soil.

Potato___healthy.symptoms: Lush foliage with clear green leaflets.
Potato___healthy.organic_remedy: Organic seaweed extract spray for immunity boost.
Potato___healthy.prevention: Keep soil well-drained and maintain proper crop rotation.

Raspberry___healthy.prevention: Prune spent fruiting canes immediately after harvest.

Soybean___healthy.organic_remedy: Inoculate soil with beneficial Rhizobium bacteria.
Soybean___healthy.prevention: Maintain optimal row spacing for canopy closure.

Squash___Powdery_mildew.symptoms: Talcut-like white powder covering leaf surfaces, leading to yellowing and premature leaf death.
Squash___Powdery_mildew.chemical_treatment: Apply Myclobutanil, Triadimefon, or Sulfur spray upon symptom appearance.
Squash___Powdery_mildew.organic_remedy: Potassium bicarbonate spray (3g/L) or diluted milk spray (1:9 ratio with water).
Squash___Powdery_mildew.prevention: Plant resistant cultivars; irrigate at soil level to keep foliage dry.

Strawberry___Leaf_scorch.symptoms: Purplish spots on upper leaf surfaces that enlarge and dry into brown 'scorched' tissue.
Strawberry___Leaf_scorch.chemical_treatment: Apply Captan or Syngenta Switch (Cyprodinil + Fludioxonil).
Strawberry___Leaf_scorch.organic_remedy: Copper soap or sulfur fungicide sprayed every 10 days.
Strawberry___Leaf_scorch.prevention: Renovate strawberry beds after harvest; clean up old leaves.

Strawberry___healthy.symptoms: Vibrant trifoliate green leaves with clear margins.
Strawberry___healthy.organic_remedy: Pine needle mulch to keep fruit clean.
Strawberry___healthy.prevention: Maintain proper plant spacing and drip irrigation.

Tomato___Bacterial_spot.symptoms: Small brown water-soaked leaf spots with yellow halos; leaves drop prematurely.
Tomato___Bacterial_spot.chemical_treatment: Apply Copper Hydroxide combined with Mancozeb every 7–10 days.
Tomato___Bacterial_spot.organic_remedy: Copper octanoate or Serenade (Bacillus subtilis) foliar spray.
Tomato___Bacterial_spot.prevention: Avoid overhead watering; disinfect tools and stakes between seasons.

Tomato___Early_blight.symptoms: Dark brown spots with characteristic concentric target rings on lower leaves first.
Tomato___Early_blight.chemical_treatment: Spray Chlorothalonil, Mancozeb, or Azoxystrobin at first sign.
Tomato___Early_blight.organic_remedy: Copper fungicide or bio-fungicide containing Trichoderma harzianum.
Tomato___Early_blight.prevention: Mulch soil surface around stem base; prune lower leaves touching soil.

Tomato___Late_blight.symptoms: Large pale green to dark water-soaked spots with white fungal fuzzy growth underneath.
Tomato___Late_blight.chemical_treatment: Systemic application of Metalaxyl-M or Chlorothalonil every 5–7 days in wet weather.
Tomato___Late_blight.prevention: Ensure high airflow; avoid planting near potatoes; destroy infected plants immediately.

Tomato___Leaf_Mold.symptoms: Pale green/yellow spots on upper leaf surface with velvety olive-green mold underneath.
Tomato___Leaf_Mold.chemical_treatment: Apply Difenoconazole or Chlorothalonil spray upon first symptoms.
Tomato___Leaf_Mold.organic_remedy: Copper fungicide or neem oil (0.5%) sprays.
Tomato___Leaf_Mold.prevention: Improve greenhouse ventilation; keep relative humidity below 85%.

Tomato___Septoria_leaf_spot.symptoms: Numerous small circular spots with dark margins and light gray centers containing black specks.
Tomato___Septoria_leaf_spot.chemical_treatment: Foliar application of Chlorothalonil or Mancozeb.
Tomato___Septoria_leaf_spot.organic_remedy: Liquid copper fungicide spray applied weekly.
Tomato___Septoria_leaf_spot.prevention: Stake plants off ground; practice 3-year crop rotation.

Tomato___Spider_mites Two-spotted_spider.symptoms: Yellow stippling/speckling on leaves with fine silken webbing on leaf undersides.
Tomato___Spider_mites Two-spotted_spider.chemical_treatment: Apply Abamectin, Spiromesifen, or Bifenazate acaricide.
Tomato___Spider_mites Two-spotted_spider.organic_remedy: Insecticidal soap, Neem oil (1%), or release predatory mites (Phytoseiulus persimilis).
Tomato___Spider_mites Two-spotted_spider.prevention: Avoid water stress; spray leaf undersides with water streams to disrupt webs.

Tomato___Target_Spot.symptoms: Target-like brown necrotic spots with light tan centers on leaves and fruits.
Tomato___Target_Spot.organic_remedy: Copper soap or Bacillus amyloliquefaciens biocontrol.
Tomato___Target_Spot.prevention: Remove crop debris after harvest; maintain optimal plant nutrition.

Tomato___Tomato_Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus.symptoms: Severe leaf curling upward, yellowing leaf margins, stunted growth, flower drop.
Tomato___Tomato_Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus.chemical_treatment: No chemical cure for virus; control Whitefly vector using Acetamiprid or Imidacloprid.
Tomato___Tomato_Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus.organic_remedy: Yellow sticky traps and neem oil spray to reduce whitefly vectors.
Tomato___Tomato_Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus.prevention: Use insect-proof netting; plant TYLCV-resistant tomato cultivars.

Tomato___Tomato_mosaic_virus.symptoms: Mottled dark green/light green mosaic pattern on leaves; fern-like leaf distortion.
Tomato___Tomato_mosaic_virus.chemical_treatment: No chemical treatment available for viral infection.
Tomato___Tomato_mosaic_virus.organic_remedy: Wash hands/tools in milk or 20% trisodium phosphate solution to stop contact spread.
Tomato___Tomato_mosaic_virus.prevention: Use virus-free certified seeds; prohibit tobacco use near tomato plants.

Tomato___healthy.symptoms: Deep green compound leaves with upright growth and vigorous stems.
Tomato___healthy.organic_remedy: Apply balanced compost and compost tea.
Tomato___healthy.prevention: Stake plants, water at soil line, and prune suckers appropriately.
